Into the reaction kettle were added 200mL DMF, 11.8g 2-tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol (99％, 0.115mol) and 8.6g potassium hydroxide (85％, 0.13mol); stirring was started and the kettle temperature was controlled at 5℃. The 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid sodium salt (98.2％, 0.1mol) prepared in step (1) was added to the reaction flask in eight portions, the total feeding time being 3h; after feeding was complete the temperature was held and the reaction run for 5h. When the reaction was complete the solvent was stripped under reduced pressure, 120mL water was added to the kettle residue, and after stirring to dissolve, concentrated hydrochloric acid was added dropwise to acidify the system to pH 3. Then filtration, water rinsing and drying gave 32.6g of product; HPLC assay gave the content of the target compound 2-chloro-3-[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxymethyl]-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid as 95.9％, a two-step reaction yield of 89.8％ calculated on 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid methyl ester.

Add 200mL of tert-butanol to the reaction flask, start stirring, and at room temperature drip in 10.3g of sodium tert-butoxide (98％, 0.105mol). 70 mL of tert-butanol was added to the reaction flask and stirring was started; at room temperature 14 g of sodium hydroxide (30%, 0.105 mol) was added dropwise. Once the sodium hydroxide was uniformly dispersed, the kettle temperature was controlled at 30 degrees C and 34.8 g of methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate (98%, 0.1 mol) was poured into the kettle to carry out the alkaline hydrolysis; the reaction was slightly exothermic, the kettle temperature was controlled at 30 degrees C, and the reaction ran for 12 h. At the end of the reaction, in-process HPLC control gave a normalised content of 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid sodium salt of 92.5%; the solvent was stripped completely under reduced pressure and the material was used directly in the subsequent etherification.

Add 200 mL of tert-butanol to the reaction flask, start stirring, and at room temperature drip in 4.6 g of sodium hydroxide (96％, 0.11 mol). The main reaction process can be represented by the following reaction equation: Drawn on the page: 2 structures. C9H7BrClNaO4S (CS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)[O][Na])c(Cl)c1CBr); C11H10ClF3O5S (CS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)O)c(Cl)c1COCC(F)(F)F). 200mL of THF was added to the sodium trifluoroethoxide; after stirring to dissolve, the reactor temperature was controlled at 5 C, and the sodium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate prepared in step (1) (98.2%, 0.1mol) was added to the reaction flask in eight portions, with a total charging time of 3h; after charging was finished the reaction was held at temperature for 3h. When the reaction was complete the solvent was stripped under reduced pressure, 120mL of water was added to the reactor residue, and after stirring to dissolve, concentrated hydrochloric acid was added dropwise to acidify the system to pH 2. Filtration, water rinsing and drying then gave 32.9g of product; HPLC assay gave a content of the target compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid of 98.7%, and a two-step yield of 93.8% based on methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate. 200mL of THF was added to the sodium trifluoroethoxide; after stirring to dissolve, the reactor temperature was controlled at 5 C, and the sodium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate prepared in step (1) (98.2%, 0.1mol) was added to the reaction flask in eight portions, with a total charging time of 3h; after charging was finished the reaction was held at temperature for 3h. The present invention belongs to the field of the synthesis of fine chemical intermediates, and relates to a process for preparing 2-chloro-3-alkoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid, and specifically relates to a process for preparing 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid and 2-chloro-3-[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxymethyl]-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid. The main reaction process can be represented by the following reaction equation: Drawn on the page: 2 structures. C9H7BrClNaO4S (CS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)[O][Na])c(Cl)c1CBr); C11H10ClF3O5S (CS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)O)c(Cl)c1COCC(F)(F)F). 200mL of THF was added to the sodium trifluoroethoxide; after stirring to dissolve, the reactor temperature was controlled at 5 C, and the sodium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate prepared in step (1) (98.2%, 0.1mol) was added to the reaction flask in eight portions, with a total charging time of 3h; after charging was finished the reaction was held at temperature for 3h. When the reaction was complete the solvent was stripped under reduced pressure, 120mL of water was added to the reactor residue, and after stirring to dissolve, concentrated hydrochloric acid was added dropwise to acidify the system to pH 2. Filtration, water rinsing and drying then gave 32.9g of product; HPLC assay gave a content of the target compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid of 98.7%, and a two-step yield of 93.8% based on methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate. 200mL of THF was added to the sodium trifluoroethoxide; after stirring to dissolve, the reactor temperature was controlled at 5 C, and the sodium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate prepared in step (1) (98.2%, 0.1mol) was added to the reaction flask in eight portions, with a total charging time of 3h; after charging was finished the reaction was held at temperature for 3h. claims.evidence_en: The present invention belongs to the field of the synthesis of fine chemical intermediates, and relates to a process for preparing 2-chloro-3-alkoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid, and specifically relates to a process for preparing 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid and 2-chloro-3-[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxymethyl]-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid. The present invention belongs to the field of the synthesis of fine chemical intermediates, and relates to a process for preparing 2-chloro-3-alkoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid, and specifically relates to a process for preparing 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid and 2-chloro-3-[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxymethyl]-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid. (2) Preparation of 2-chloro-3-[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxymethyl]-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid; the main reaction process can be represented by the following reaction equation: (2) Preparation of 2-chloro-3-[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxymethyl]-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid; the main reaction process can be represented by the following reaction equation: Drawn on the page: 2 structures. C9H7BrClNaO4S (CS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)[O-])c(Cl)c1CBr.[Na+]); C14H17ClO6S (CS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)O)c(Cl)c1COCC1CCCO1). Into the reactor were added 130 mL THF, 10.8 g 2-tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol (99%, 0.105 mol) and 11.8 g sodium tert-butoxide (98%, 0.12 mol); stirring was started and the kettle temperature was controlled at 10 degC. The sodium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate prepared in step (1) (98.3%, 0.1 mol) was added to the reaction flask in eight portions, with a total addition time of 3 h; after addition was complete the mixture was held at temperature and reacted for 4 h. When the reaction was complete, the solvent was stripped under reduced pressure, 120 mL water was added to the kettle residue, and after stirring to dissolve, concentrated hydrochloric acid was added dropwise to acidify the system to pH 3. After filtration, water rinsing and drying, 33.0 g of product was obtained; HPLC assay gave the target compound 2-chloro-3-[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxymethyl]-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid at a content of 96.6%, and a two-step reaction yield of 91.4% based on methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate. claims.evidence_en: The present invention belongs to the field of the synthesis of fine chemical intermediates, and relates to a process for preparing 2-chloro-3-alkoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid, and specifically relates to a process for preparing 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid and 2-chloro-3-[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxymethyl]-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid. The present invention belongs to the field of the synthesis of fine chemical intermediates, and relates to a process for preparing 2-chloro-3-alkoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid, and specifically relates to a process for preparing 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid and 2-chloro-3-[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxymethyl]-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid. (2) Preparation of 2-chloro-3-[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxymethyl]-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid; the main reaction process can be represented by the following reaction equation: (2) Preparation of 2-chloro-3-[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxymethyl]-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid; the main reaction process can be represented by the following reaction equation: Drawn on the page: 2 structures. C9H7BrClNaO4S (CS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)[O-])c(Cl)c1CBr.[Na+]); C14H17ClO6S (CS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)O)c(Cl)c1COCC1CCCO1). Into the reactor were added 130 mL THF, 10.8 g 2-tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol (99%, 0.105 mol) and 11.8 g sodium tert-butoxide (98%, 0.12 mol); stirring was started and the kettle temperature was controlled at 10 degC. The sodium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate prepared in step (1) (98.3%, 0.1 mol) was added to the reaction flask in eight portions, with a total addition time of 3 h; after addition was complete the mixture was held at temperature and reacted for 4 h. When the reaction was complete, the solvent was stripped under reduced pressure, 120 mL water was added to the kettle residue, and after stirring to dissolve, concentrated hydrochloric acid was added dropwise to acidify the system to pH 3. After filtration, water rinsing and drying, 33.0 g of product was obtained; HPLC assay gave the target compound 2-chloro-3-[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxymethyl]-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid at a content of 96.6%, and a two-step reaction yield of 91.4% based on methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate. Into the reaction flask was added 200 mL of tert-butanol; stirring was started, and at room temperature 2.4 g of sodium metal (99％, 0.105 mol) was added into it. After the sodium metal had dissolved completely, the vessel temperature was controlled at 25℃, and 34.8 g of methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate (98％, 0.1 mol) was poured into the vessel to carry out the alkaline hydrolysis reaction. The reaction was slightly exothermic; the vessel temperature was controlled at 25℃ and the reaction ran for 6 h. After the reaction ended, in-process liquid chromatography gave a normalised content of 98.3％ for sodium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate. The solvent was stripped off completely under reduced pressure and the material was used directly in the subsequent etherification reaction. The present invention relates to a process for the preparation of 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid, the process comprising the following steps: the starting material methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate undergoes an ester cleavage reaction in a tertiary alcohol solvent in the presence of a basic substance to give a 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt; the 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt is reacted with an alcohol in the presence of a basic substance, or alternatively the 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt is reacted with an alkali metal alkoxide, to give the said 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid. Although the target compound can be obtained by the above method, the purity of the product obtained is rather poor, and the impurity 2-chloro-3-methoxymethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid accounts for a relatively large proportion. The proportion of this impurity differs considerably with the substrate: when R is trifluoroethyl the normalised proportion of this impurity is about 3 to 5％, and when R is 2-tetrahydrofurylmethyl the normalised proportion can reach 8 to 12％. This impurity arises because, in the basic environment, the ester in the starting material undergoes base cleavage or transesterification and gives methanol as a byproduct, and the methanol reacts further with the benzyl bromide group of the starting material. Because this impurity is fairly similar in structure and properties to the target compound, it is not easily removed; carried into the subsequent reaction it gives rise to corresponding new impurities, and it ultimately seriously affects the quality of the tembotrione and tefuryltrione technical material.

claims.question_en: `conditions.time_h` cannot hold what the patent prints, 16 times over. Is widening it worth it?
risk_reasons_en: One schema limitation, hit 16 times.
claims.severity_action_en: Nothing here is wrong and nothing here can be marked wrong. The patent prints this, the annotation read it, and the field it had to go in is too small to hold it. This is a schema ticket, not a review decision.

Nothing was misread and re-running the extraction changes nothing: the field cannot hold the answer.

claims.claimed_en: Abstract. The present invention relates to a process for the preparation of 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid, the process comprising the following steps: the starting material methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate undergoes an ester cleavage reaction in a tertiary alcohol solvent in the presence of a basic substance to give a 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt; the 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt is reacted with an alcohol in the presence of a basic substance, or alternatively the 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt is reacted with an alkali metal alkoxide, to give the said 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid. In the preparation process provided by the present invention a tertiary alcohol is used as the solvent and the starting material undergoes the ester cleavage reaction in the presence of a basic substance, which lowers the content of impurities; the yield and the quality of the target compound are greatly raised, which provides a safeguard for the final synthesis of high quality tembotrione and tefuryltrione technical material.

evidence_lines.text_en: Abstract. The present invention relates to a process for the preparation of 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid, the process comprising the following steps: the starting material methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate undergoes an ester cleavage reaction in a tertiary alcohol solvent in the presence of a basic substance to give a 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt; the 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt is reacted with an alcohol in the presence of a basic substance, or alternatively the 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt is reacted with an alkali metal alkoxide, to give the said 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid. claims.evidence_en: Abstract. The present invention relates to a process for the preparation of 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid, the process comprising the following steps: the starting material methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate undergoes an ester cleavage reaction in a tertiary alcohol solvent in the presence of a basic substance to give a 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt; the 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt is reacted with an alcohol in the presence of a basic substance, or alternatively the 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt is reacted with an alkali metal alkoxide, to give the said 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid. In the preparation process provided by the present invention a tertiary alcohol is used as the solvent and the starting material undergoes the ester cleavage reaction in the presence of a basic substance, which lowers the content of impurities; the yield and the quality of the target compound are greatly raised, which provides a safeguard for the final synthesis of high quality tembotrione and tefuryltrione technical material. evidence_lines.text_en: Abstract. The present invention relates to a process for the preparation of 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid, the process comprising the following steps: the starting material methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate undergoes an ester cleavage reaction in a tertiary alcohol solvent in the presence of a basic substance to give a 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt; the 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt is reacted with an alcohol in the presence of a basic substance, or alternatively the 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt is reacted with an alkali metal alkoxide, to give the said 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid. In the preparation process provided by the present invention a tertiary alcohol is used as the solvent and the starting material undergoes the ester cleavage reaction in the presence of a basic substance, which lowers the content of impurities; the yield and the quality of the target compound are greatly raised, which provides a safeguard for the final synthesis of high quality tembotrione and tefuryltrione technical material.

200mL of tert-amyl alcohol was added to the reaction flask and stirring was started; at room temperature 8.8g of sodium hydroxide (48%, 0.105mol) was added dropwise into it, and once the sodium hydroxide was uniformly dispersed the reactor temperature was controlled at 25 C, and 34.8g of methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate (98%, 0.1mol) was poured into the reactor to carry out the alkaline hydrolysis reaction. The reaction was slightly exothermic; the reactor temperature was controlled at 25 C and the reaction was run for 7h. After the reaction was complete, in-process liquid chromatography gave a normalised content of sodium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate of 97.8%; the solvent was stripped off completely under reduced pressure and the material was used directly in the subsequent etherification reaction.

claims.evidence_en: Abstract. The present invention relates to a process for the preparation of 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid, the process comprising the following steps: the starting material methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate undergoes an ester cleavage reaction in a tertiary alcohol solvent in the presence of a basic substance to give a 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt; the 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt is reacted with an alcohol in the presence of a basic substance, or alternatively the 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt is reacted with an alkali metal alkoxide, to give the said 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid. In the preparation process provided by the present invention a tertiary alcohol is used as the solvent and the starting material undergoes the ester cleavage reaction in the presence of a basic substance, which lowers the content of impurities; the yield and the quality of the target compound are greatly raised, which provides a safeguard for the final synthesis of high quality tembotrione and tefuryltrione technical material. claims.evidence_en: Abstract. The present invention relates to a process for the preparation of 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid, the process comprising the following steps: the starting material methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate undergoes an ester cleavage reaction in a tertiary alcohol solvent in the presence of a basic substance to give a 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt; the 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt is reacted with an alcohol in the presence of a basic substance, or alternatively the 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt is reacted with an alkali metal alkoxide, to give the said 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid. To solve the above technical problem, the present invention provides a process for preparing 2-chloro-3-alkoxymethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid which effectively avoids the formation of the impurity 2-chloro-3-methoxymethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, and thereby provides assurance for the subsequent preparation of high quality tembotrione and tefuryltrione technical material. A process for preparing 2-chloro-3-alkoxymethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, comprising the following steps: A process for preparing 2-chloro-3-alkoxymethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, comprising the following steps: (2) the 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate salt is reacted with an alcohol in the presence of a basic substance, or else the 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate salt is reacted with an alkali metal alkoxide, to give the said 2-chloro-3-alkoxymethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid. (2) the 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate salt is reacted with an alcohol in the presence of a basic substance, or else the 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate salt is reacted with an alkali metal alkoxide, to give the said 2-chloro-3-alkoxymethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid. Preferably, after the reaction in step (2) is complete, the said 2-chloro-3-alkoxymethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid is obtained through acidification. Preferably, after the reaction in step (2) is complete, the said 2-chloro-3-alkoxymethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid is obtained through acidification. Into the reactor were added 130 mL DMF, 10.8 g 2-tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol (99%, 0.105 mol) and 14.1 g potassium tert-butoxide (95%, 0.12 mol); stirring was started and the kettle temperature was controlled at 10 degC. The potassium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate prepared in step (1) (98.1%, 0.1 mol) was added to the reaction flask in eight portions, with a total addition time of 3 h; after addition was complete the mixture was held at temperature and reacted for 4 h. When the reaction was complete, the solvent was stripped under reduced pressure, 120 mL water was added to the kettle residue, and after stirring to dissolve, concentrated hydrochloric acid was added dropwise to acidify the system to pH 3. After filtration, water rinsing and drying, 33.0 g of product was obtained; HPLC assay gave the target compound 2-chloro-3-[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxymethyl]-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid at a content of 96.8%, and a two-step reaction yield of 91.8% based on methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate.

150 mL of 2-tetrahydrofuranmethanol was charged to the reaction kettle and stirring was started; 20 g potassium hydride (30％, 0.15 mol) was added at room temperature and stirred until completely dissolved; after stripping the solvent under reduced pressure with a high-vacuum oil pump, solid potassium 2-tetrahydrofuranmethanolate was obtained and kept sealed for later use.

To the potassium 2-tetrahydrofuranmethanolate was added 200 mL THF; after stirring to dissolve, the kettle temperature was controlled at 5 degrees C, and the sodium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate prepared in step (1) (98.2％, 0.1 mol) was added to the reaction flask in eight portions, the total charging time being 3 h; after charging was complete the mixture was held at temperature for 3 h. claims.evidence_en: Title of invention: A process for the preparation of 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid Title of invention: A process for the preparation of 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid Abstract. The present invention relates to a process for the preparation of 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid, the process comprising the following steps: the starting material methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate undergoes an ester cleavage reaction in a tertiary alcohol solvent in the presence of a basic substance to give a 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt; the 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt is reacted with an alcohol in the presence of a basic substance, or alternatively the 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt is reacted with an alkali metal alkoxide, to give the said 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid. In the preparation process provided by the present invention a tertiary alcohol is used as the solvent and the starting material undergoes the ester cleavage reaction in the presence of a basic substance, which lowers the content of impurities; the yield and the quality of the target compound are greatly raised, which provides a safeguard for the final synthesis of high quality tembotrione and tefuryltrione technical material. Title of invention: A process for the preparation of 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid

Abstract. The present invention relates to a process for the preparation of 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid, the process comprising the following steps: the starting material methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate undergoes an ester cleavage reaction in a tertiary alcohol solvent in the presence of a basic substance to give a 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt; the 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt is reacted with an alcohol in the presence of a basic substance, or alternatively the 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt is reacted with an alkali metal alkoxide, to give the said 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid. In the preparation process provided by the present invention a tertiary alcohol is used as the solvent and the starting material undergoes the ester cleavage reaction in the presence of a basic substance, which lowers the content of impurities; the yield and the quality of the target compound are greatly raised, which provides a safeguard for the final synthesis of high quality tembotrione and tefuryltrione technical material.

The present invention relates to a process for the preparation of 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid, the process comprising the following steps: the starting material methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate undergoes an ester cleavage reaction in a tertiary alcohol solvent in the presence of a basic substance to give a 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt; the 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt is reacted with an alcohol in the presence of a basic substance, or alternatively the 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt is reacted with an alkali metal alkoxide, to give the said 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid. In the preparation process provided by the present invention a tertiary alcohol is used as the solvent and the starting material undergoes the ester cleavage reaction in the presence of a basic substance, which lowers the content of impurities; the yield and the quality of the target compound are greatly raised, which provides a safeguard for the final synthesis of high quality tembotrione and tefuryltrione technical material.

The proportion of this impurity differs considerably with the substrate: when R is trifluoroethyl the normalised proportion of this impurity is about 3 to 5％, and when R is 2-tetrahydrofurylmethyl the normalised proportion can reach 8 to 12％. This impurity arises because, in the basic environment, the ester in the starting material undergoes base cleavage or transesterification and gives methanol as a byproduct, and the methanol reacts further with the benzyl bromide group of the starting material. Because this impurity is fairly similar in structure and properties to the target compound, it is not easily removed; carried into the subsequent reaction it gives rise to corresponding new impurities, and it ultimately seriously affects the quality of the tembotrione and tefuryltrione technical material.

Title of invention: A process for the preparation of 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid

Abstract. The present invention relates to a process for the preparation of 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid, the process comprising the following steps: the starting material methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate undergoes an ester cleavage reaction in a tertiary alcohol solvent in the presence of a basic substance to give a 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt; the 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt is reacted with an alcohol in the presence of a basic substance, or alternatively the 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt is reacted with an alkali metal alkoxide, to give the said 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid. In the preparation process provided by the present invention a tertiary alcohol is used as the solvent and the starting material undergoes the ester cleavage reaction in the presence of a basic substance, which lowers the content of impurities; the yield and the quality of the target compound are greatly raised, which provides a safeguard for the final synthesis of high quality tembotrione and tefuryltrione technical material.
